subject: What the Dark Mirror mineral-clearing framework is trying to do
script: From Agewell Brief: What the Dark Mirror mineral-clearing framework is trying to do. Dark Mirror is the advanced mineral-clearing layer of the Spiral of Cellular Light. Its framework combines binding materials with mineral transport, then places the cycle between broader protocol phases. “Chelation” is a serious word.
